news.headline: Patterson was limited to just one field-goal try for the second straight week, converting a 27-yarder early in the third
news.detail: Patterson was limited to just one field-goal try for the second straight week, converting a 27-yarder early in the third quarter. The kicker has gone 6-for-8 on field-goal attempts this season, and he doesn't seem likely to suddenly see more opportunities moving forward while finishing off the drive
